unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: अर्को फेच र कार्यान्वयन गरिने निर्देशन (Instruction) को मेमोरी ठेगाना कुन दर्ता (Register) मा सुरक्षित हुन्छ?
question_english: Which CPU register holds the memory address of the next machine instruction to be fetched and executed?
explanation:
The Program Counter (PC) automatically increments to point to the address of the subsequent instruction to be executed.

नेपाली व्याख्या: प्रोग्राम काउन्टर (PC) ले अर्को कार्यान्वयन हुने इन्स्ट्रक्सनको मेमोरी ठेगाना सुरक्षित राख्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: मेमोरीबाट पढिएको वा मेमोरीमा लेख्न लागिएको डेटालाई अस्थायी रूपमा राख्ने दर्ता कुन हो?
question_english: The register that temporarily holds data read from or waiting to be written into main memory is called:
options: Memory Data Register (MDR) / Memory Buffer Register (MBR)
explanation:
The MDR (also known as MBR) holds the data contents fetched from or destined to be stored in the address pointed to by the MAR.

नेपाली व्याख्या: MDR (Memory Data Register) ले मेमोरीमा लेख्न वा पढ्न लागिएको वास्तविक डेटा होल्ड गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: इन्स्ट्रक्सन रजिस्टर (IR) को मुख्य भूमिका के हो?
question_english: What is the primary role of the Instruction Register (IR)?
options: To count the clock pulses of the CPU
To hold the opcode of the current instruction while it is being decoded by the Control Unit
To store the result of an ALU addition
To store the return address of subroutines
explanation:
The Instruction Register (IR) stores the binary instruction fetched from memory during the decode phase of the instruction cycle.

नेपाली व्याख्या: IR (Instruction Register) ले हाल डिकोड र प्रोसेस भइरहेको इन्स्ट्रक्सनलाई होल्ड गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: सब-रुटिन र इन्टरप्टको समयमा स्ट्याकको शीर्ष विन्दुको ठेगाना राख्ने रजिस्टर कुन हो?
question_english: Which special register holds the memory address of the top element of the call stack for subroutines and interrupts?
explanation:
The Stack Pointer (SP) points to the last allocated memory address on the LIFO call stack.

नेपाली व्याख्या: स्ट्याक पोइन्टर (SP) ले LIFO स्ट्याकको सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो (Top) ठेगानालाई देखाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: कम्प्युटरका सम्पूर्ण हार्डवेयर कम्पोनेन्टहरू बीच डेटाको आदानप्रदान नियन्त्रण र समन्वय गर्ने मुख्य एकाइ कुन हो?
question_english: Which CPU component generates the timing and control signals necessary to coordinate data movement across buses and functional units?
explanation:
The Control Unit (CU) interprets instructions and issues synchronized timing and micro-operation signals to the datapath.

नेपाली व्याख्या: कन्ट्रोल युनिट (CU) ले सम्पूर्ण प्रणालीका लागि आवश्यक टाइमिङ र नियन्त्रण सिग्नलहरू उत्पन्न गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: RISC र CISC प्रोसेसर बीचको मुख्य वास्तुकला भिन्नता के हो?
question_english: What is the key architectural difference between RISC and CISC processors?
options: RISC uses variable-length instructions; CISC uses fixed-length
RISC relies on a small set of simple, single-cycle instructions with a load/store architecture, whereas CISC provides rich, complex multi-cycle instructions
CISC has more general registers than RISC
explanation:
RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer) emphasizes simple, uniform instructions executing in single cycles via load/store, while CISC uses hardware microcode for complex instructions.

नेपाली व्याख्या: RISC मा सरल र एउटै साइकलमा चल्ने इन्स्ट्रक्सनहरू हुन्छन् भने CISC मा जटिल र धेरै साइकल लिने इन्स्ट्रक्सनहरू हुन्छन्।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: अत्यधिक गति र रिफ्रेस गर्न नपर्ने विशेषताका कारण CPU को L1, L2 र L3 क्यास बनाउन कुन मेमोरी प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which memory technology is used to build CPU L1, L2, and L3 cache memory due to its extreme speed and lack of refresh requirements?
explanation:
SRAM uses flip-flops (typically 6 transistors per cell) to store bits without periodic refreshing, providing near-CPU cycle access times.

नेपाली व्याख्या: SRAM (Static RAM) मा डेटा सुरक्षित राख्न बारम्बार रिफ्रेस गर्नु पर्दैन, जसले गर्दा यो क्यास मेमोरीका लागि उपयुक्त हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: क्यास मेमोरीको प्रभावकारिता बढाउने 'Locality of Reference' सिद्धान्तका दुई मुख्य पक्ष कुन हुन्?
question_english: The principle of 'Locality of Reference' that enables cache memory efficiency consists of which two dimensions?
options: Temporal Locality (recent access) and Spatial Locality (adjacent memory addresses)
explanation:
Temporal locality states that recently accessed items are likely to be accessed again soon. Spatial locality states that nearby memory items are likely to be accessed next.

नेपाली व्याख्या: टेम्पोरल लोकालिटी (भर्खरै प्रयोग भएको डेटा पुन: प्रयोग हुने) र स्पेसियल लोकालिटी (नजिकको ठेगानाको डेटा प्रयोग हुने) यसका आधार हुन्।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: क्यास मेमोरीमा डेटा लेख्दा क्यास र मुख्य मेमोरी दुवैमा एकैसाथ अपडेट गर्ने नीतिलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: In cache organization, which write policy immediately updates both the cache block and the underlying main memory concurrently?
explanation:
Write-through writes directly to both cache and main memory simultaneously, ensuring strict coherence at the expense of higher memory write traffic.

नेपाली व्याख्या: राइट-थ्रु (Write-Through) नीतिमा क्यास र मुख्य र्‍याम (RAM) दुवैमा एकैपटक डेटा लेखिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: क्यास मेमोरीमा सबैभन्दा लामो समयदेखि प्रयोग नभएको ब्लकलाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्ने एल्गोरिदम कुन हो?
question_english: In a 2-way set-associative cache, what page/block replacement algorithm discards the block that has not been referenced for the longest period?
explanation:
LRU (Least Recently Used) keeps track of block access recency and replaces the one idle the longest, offering superior hit ratios.

नेपाली व्याख्या: LRU (Least Recently Used) एल्गोरिदमले सबैभन्दा लामो समयदेखि प्रयोग नगरिएको क्यास ब्लक हटाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: भर्चुअल ठेगानालाई भौतिक मेमोरी ठेगानामा छिटो रूपान्तरण गर्न प्रयोग गरिने विशेष हार्डवेयर क्यास कुन हो?
question_english: What hardware component accelerates virtual-to-physical address translation by serving as a high-speed cache of recently used page table entries?
explanation:
The Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) is an associative cache located inside the MMU that stores recent virtual-to-physical address mappings.

नेपाली व्याख्या: TLB (Translation Lookaside Buffer) ले भर्चुअल ठेगानालाई भौतिक ठेगानामा बदल्ने काम तीव्र बनाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: प्रोग्रामले खोजेको पेज मुख्य मेमोरी (RAM) मा नभेटिँदा कुन इन्टरप्ट उत्पन्न हुन्छ?
question_english: When a program attempts to access a page that is mapped in the virtual address space but is currently not loaded into physical RAM, what hardware interrupt occurs?
explanation:
A Page Fault is a hardware trap generated by the MMU, prompting the operating system to fetch the required page from swap/secondary storage.

नेपाली व्याख्या: पेज फल्ट (Page Fault) उत्पन्न हुँदा अपरेटिङ सिस्टमले आवश्यक डेटा सेकेन्डरी स्टोरेज (डिस्क) बाट र्‍याममा ल्याउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: मेमोरीमा वास्तविक काम गर्नुको सट्टा निरन्तर पेज स्वापिङ (Page Swapping) मै समय खेर जाने अवस्थालाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: What operating system phenomenon occurs when excessive time is spent swapping pages in and out of memory rather than executing useful work?
explanation:
Thrashing occurs when the working sets of active processes exceed physical RAM, causing continuous page faults and near-zero CPU throughput.

नेपाली व्याख्या: थ्र्यासिङ (Thrashing) त्यस्तो अवस्था हो जहाँ कम्प्युटरले निर्देशन कार्यान्वयन गर्नुको सट्टा पेज अदलबदल (Swap) मै अधिकांश समय खर्च गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: हार्ड डिस्कमा रिड/राइट हेडलाई लक्षित ट्र्याक वा सिलिन्डर सम्म पुग्न लाग्ने समयलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: In traditional Hard Disk Drives (HDDs), what metric measures the time required for the read/write head to move to the targeted track or cylinder?
explanation:
Seek Time is the mechanical delay for the actuator arm to position the magnetic read/write head over the desired cylinder/track.

नेपाली व्याख्या: सिक टाइम (Seek Time) भनेको रिड/राइट हेडलाई सम्बन्धित ट्र्याकमा पुग्न लाग्ने समय हो।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: हार्ड डिस्कको रोटेसनल ल्याटेन्सी (Rotational Latency) कुन प्राविधिक पक्षमा निर्भर गर्दछ?
question_english: Rotational latency of a mechanical hard drive is directly determined by which drive specification?
options: Spindle Speed in RPM (Revolutions Per Minute)
explanation:
Rotational latency is the time for the targeted sector to rotate under the head, averaging half a revolution: $\frac{1}{2 \times (\text{RPM}/60)}$ seconds.

नेपाली व्याख्या: रोटेसनल ल्याटेन्सी डिस्क कति छिटो घुम्छ भन्ने कुरामा निर्भर गर्दछ, जसलाई RPM (Revolutions Per Minute) मा नापिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: कम्तीमा तीनवटा डिस्क प्रयोग गरी डिस्ट्रिब्युटेड प्यारिटी मार्फत एउटा डिस्क बिग्रँदा पनि डेटा सुरक्षित राख्ने RAID तह कुन हो?
question_english: Which RAID level provides block-level striping with distributed parity across at least three physical drives to allow single-drive fault tolerance?
explanation:
RAID 5 provides both performance and data redundancy with distributed parity across $\ge 3$ drives. It can withstand the failure of any 1 drive.

नेपाली व्याख्या: RAID 5 मा डिस्ट्रिब्युटेड प्यारिटी प्रयोग गरिन्छ, जसले गर्दा कुनै एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए पनि बाँकी डिस्कबाट डेटा पुनर्निर्माण गर्न सकिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: नेटवर्क कार्ड र हार्ड डिस्कमा डेटा सञ्चार गर्दा इन्टरप्ट-ड्रिभनको तुलनामा DMA (Direct Memory Access) को मुख्य फाइदा के हो?
question_english: What is the primary advantage of Direct Memory Access (DMA) over interrupt-driven I/O in high-throughput network adapters and disk controllers?
options: DMA transfers bulk data blocks directly between device buffers and RAM without CPU intervention per byte
DMA doubles the clock frequency of the processor
explanation:
DMA allows high-speed peripherals to transfer blocks of data directly to/from main memory without routing every byte through the CPU, freeing the CPU for compute tasks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: DMA ले CPU लाई व्यस्त नबनाई बाह्य डिभाइस र र्‍याम बीच सिधै ठूलो मात्रामा डेटा आदानप्रदान गर्न अनुमति दिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: DMA को कुन मोडमा CPU को काममा बाधा नपुर्‍याई प्रत्येक बस साइकलमा एउटा वर्ड डेटा आदानप्रदान गरिन्छ?
question_english: In DMA transfer modes, what mode allows the DMA controller to seize the system bus for a single bus cycle to transfer one word between CPU operations?
explanation:
Cycle Stealing mode transfers one word at a time during bus cycles, temporarily borrowing the bus from the CPU with minimal CPU stall.

नेपाली व्याख्या: साइकल स्टिलिङ (Cycle Stealing) मोडमा DMA ले CPU को बसबाट एक-एक साइकल चोरेर थोरै थोरै डेटा ट्रान्सफर गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: भेक्टर्ड इन्टरप्ट (Vectored Interrupt) ले के जनाउँछ?
question_english: What is a 'Vectored Interrupt'?
options: An interrupt that can never be masked by software
An interrupt where the interrupting device directly supplies the address or index of its Interrupt Service Routine (ISR)
A software exception generated by division by zero
An interrupt executed only in user mode
explanation:
In vectored interrupts, the interrupting peripheral provides an interrupt vector (address or vector number) on the data bus, directing the CPU immediately to its specific ISR.

नेपाली व्याख्या: भेक्टर्ड इन्टरप्टमा डिभाइसले नै आफ्नो सेवा गर्ने कोड (ISR) को ठेगाना सिधै CPU लाई उपलब्ध गराउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: Memory-Mapped I/O र Isolated I/O बीचको मुख्य भिन्नता के हो?
question_english: What is the key difference between Memory-Mapped I/O and Isolated (Port-Mapped) I/O?
options: Memory-Mapped I/O shares the same 16/32-bit address space and machine instructions for both RAM and device registers, whereas Isolated I/O uses dedicated I/O instructions (e.g., IN/OUT)
Isolated I/O is faster than memory-mapped I/O
Memory-mapped I/O cannot access video cards
Isolated I/O does not require a data bus
explanation:
Memory-mapped I/O treats device registers as standard memory locations using standard load/store instructions. Isolated I/O uses separate address spaces and dedicated IN/OUT CPU instructions.

नेपाली व्याख्या: Memory-Mapped I/O मा मेमोरी र I/O डिभाइस दुवैले एउटै ठेगाना प्रणाली प्रयोग गर्छन् भने Isolated I/O मा छुट्टै कमान्ड (IN/OUT) हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: क्यास मेमोरीमा राइट मिस (Write Miss) हुँदा नयाँ क्यास ब्लक छुट्याउने नीति कुन हो?
question_english: Which cache write-miss allocation policy allocates a cache block for the incoming data upon a write miss?
explanation:
Write-Allocate loads the targeted memory block into cache upon a write miss before performing the write, commonly paired with write-back caches.

नेपाली व्याख्या: राइट-एलोकेट (Write-Allocate) नीतिले राइट मिस हुँदा मुख्य मेमोरीबाट सम्बन्धित ब्लक क्यासमा तानेर ल्याउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: आधुनिक NVMe SSD हरूलाई अत्यधिक गतिको पोइन्ट-टु-पोइन्ट लेनहरू (x4, x8) प्रदान गर्ने बस मानक कुन हो?
question_english: Which secondary storage interface bus standard provides high-speed serial point-to-point connections with dedicated lanes (x1, x4, x8, x16) for modern NVMe solid-state drives?
explanation:
PCI Express (PCIe) provides high-bandwidth, low-latency point-to-point serial lanes utilized directly by modern NVMe SSDs, bypassing legacy SATA bottlenecks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: PCI Express (PCIe) बसले आधुनिक NVMe ड्राइभहरूलाई उच्च ब्यान्डविथ र कम विलम्बता (Low latency) प्रदान गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: कम्प्युटर प्रणालीमा MMU (Memory Management Unit) को मुख्य कार्य के हो?
question_english: What is the function of the Memory Management Unit (MMU) in a computer system?
options: To translate virtual addresses into physical addresses and enforce hardware memory protection
To perform arithmetic calculations on addresses
explanation:
The MMU is a dedicated hardware module that translates logical/virtual addresses generated by the CPU into physical RAM addresses while enforcing read/write privileges.

नेपाली व्याख्या: MMU ले CPU द्वारा सिर्जना गरिएको भर्चुअल ठेगानालाई वास्तविक र्‍यामको भौतिक ठेगानामा रूपान्तरण गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: इन्स्ट्रक्सन र डेटाका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै भौतिक बस प्रयोग गरी एकैपटक दुवै काम गर्न सक्ने कम्प्युटर वास्तुकला कुन हो?
question_english: Which type of computer bus architecture uses separate physical buses for instructions and data, allowing simultaneous instruction fetch and data operand access?
explanation:
Harvard architecture physically separates memory storage and signal pathways for instructions and data, avoiding the Von Neumann bottleneck.

नेपाली व्याख्या: हार्वर्ड आर्किटेक्चर (Harvard Architecture) मा इन्स्ट्रक्सन र डेटाका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै बस हुन्छन्, जसले गर्दा दुवै काम एकैपटक सम्भव हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: पाइपलाइन्ड प्रोसेसरमा अघिल्लो निर्देशनको नतिजा आउनु अगावै पछिल्लो निर्देशनले त्यसलाई प्रयोग गर्न खोज्दा कुन समस्या (Hazard) आउँछ?
question_english: In pipelined processors, what type of hazard occurs when an instruction depends on the result of a preceding instruction that has not yet completed execution?
explanation:
Data hazards (specifically RAW - Read After Write) happen when instruction operands depend on earlier in-flight instructions. Solved by operand forwarding or pipeline stalls.

नेपाली व्याख्या: डेटा हजार्ड (Data Hazard) त्यतिबेला हुन्छ जब कुनै निर्देशनले अघिल्लो निर्देशनबाट आउने नतिजा पर्खनु पर्दछ।

question_nepali: इन्स्ट्रक्सन र डेटाका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै भौतिक बस प्रयोग गरी एकैपटक दुवै काम गर्न सक्ने कम्प्युटर वास्तुकला कुन हो?
question_english: Which type of computer bus architecture uses separate physical buses for instructions and data, allowing simultaneous instruction fetch and data operand access?
explanation:
Harvard architecture physically separates memory storage and signal pathways for instructions and data, avoiding the Von Neumann bottleneck.

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: पाइपलाइन्ड प्रोसेसरमा अघिल्लो निर्देशनको नतिजा आउनु अगावै पछिल्लो निर्देशनले त्यसलाई प्रयोग गर्न खोज्दा कुन समस्या (Hazard) आउँछ?
question_english: In pipelined processors, what type of hazard occurs when an instruction depends on the result of a preceding instruction that has not yet completed execution?

unit_title: Unit 2: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy & I/O
question_nepali: क्यास मेमोरीमा राइट मिस (Write Miss) हुँदा नयाँ क्यास ब्लक छुट्याउने नीति कुन हो?

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: इथरनेट नेटवर्क स्विच (Switch) मुख्यतया OSI मोडलको कुन तहमा काम गर्दछ?
question_english: At which layer of the OSI reference model does an Ethernet network switch primarily operate?
explanation:
Standard Ethernet switches operate at Layer 2 (Data Link Layer) and use hardware MAC address tables to filter and forward frames to specific destination ports.

नेपाली व्याख्या: परम्परागत नेटवर्क स्विचले डाटा लिंक लेयर (Layer 2) मा MAC ठेगानाका आधारमा फ्रेमहरू पठाउने काम गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: नेटवर्क हब (Hub) र स्विच (Switch) बीचको मुख्य प्राविधिक भिन्नता के हो?
question_english: What is the key functional difference between a network Hub and a network Switch?
options: Hubs are Layer 3 devices; switches are Layer 1
A Hub broadcasts all incoming frames to every connected port creating a single collision domain, whereas a Switch forwards frames selectively creating separate collision domains per port
Hubs encrypt network traffic; switches do not
Switches cannot connect to twisted pair cables
explanation:
A hub is a multiport repeater (Layer 1) that broadcasts bits to all ports, sharing collisions. A switch (Layer 2) inspects MAC addresses and creates dedicated collision-free micro-segments per port.

नेपाली व्याख्या: हबले सबै पोर्टमा डेटा ब्रोडकास्ट गर्दछ जसले कोलिजन बढाउँछ, तर स्विचले सम्बन्धित डिभाइसको MAC ठेगानामा मात्र डेटा पठाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: विभिन्न IP सबनेट र नेटवर्कहरू बीच प्याकेटहरू आदानप्रदान गर्न कुन उपकरण प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which networking device is specifically designed to route packets between different logical IP subnets and autonomous systems?
explanation:
A router is a Layer 3 (Network Layer) device that examines destination IP addresses and consults routing tables to forward packets across different networks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: राउटर (Router) ले नेटवर्क लेयर (Layer 3) मा IP ठेगाना हेरेर प्याकेटहरूलाई सही गन्तव्यमा पठाउने काम गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: लामो दूरीमा कमजोर भएको सिग्नललाई पुनः बलियो बनाएर पठाउने Layer 1 को उपकरण कुन हो?
question_english: Which network device operates at OSI Layer 1 to regenerate and retime incoming electrical or optical signals over long cable runs?
explanation:
A repeater operates at Layer 1 (Physical Layer), receiving weak, attenuated signals and amplifying/regenerating them before transmitting them down the line.

नेपाली व्याख्या: रिपिटर (Repeater) ले भौतिक तहमा कमजोर भएको सिग्नललाई एम्प्लिफाई गरी लामो दूरी सम्म पुर्‍याउन मद्दत गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: डाटा पठाउनु अघि नै दुई छेउ बीच स्थायी र समर्पित भौतिक बाटो तयार गर्ने प्रविधि कुन हो?
question_english: Which switching technology establishes a dedicated, continuous physical end-to-end communication path prior to any data transmission (e.g., traditional PSTN phone calls)?
explanation:
Circuit switching reserves dedicated bandwidth and a fixed physical circuit for the entire call duration (with setup and teardown overhead), such as in landline telephone networks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: सर्किट स्विचिङ (Circuit Switching) मा कुराकानी सुरु हुनु अगावै दुई यन्त्र बीच स्थायी बाटो तय गरिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: प्याकेट-स्विच नेटवर्कमा 'डाटाग्राम' (Datagram) दृष्टिकोणको मुख्य विशेषता के हो?
question_english: In packet-switched networks, what characterizes the 'Datagram' approach?
options: All packets follow the exact same path established in advance
Each packet is treated as an independent unit containing destination headers and can travel along different network routes
No headers are added to packets
explanation:
In the datagram approach (connectionless), every packet is routed independently by intermediate routers and may arrive out of order at the destination.

नेपाली व्याख्या: डाटाग्राम पद्धतिमा प्रत्येक प्याकेट स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ र फरक-फरक बाटो हुँदै गन्तव्यमा पुग्न सक्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: Cat6 UTP केबलबाट १ Gbps गतिमा डाटा पठाउन सकिने अधिकतम दूरी कति हो?
question_english: What is the maximum standard segment distance for unshielded twisted pair (UTP Cat6) Ethernet cables operating at 1 Gbps?
explanation:
Standard Ethernet twisted-pair cabling (Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a) is specified by TIA/EIA standards to have a maximum channel distance of 100 meters (90m horizontal + 10m patch cables).

नेपाली व्याख्या: Cat6 इथरनेट केबलको अधिकतम मानक प्रसारण दूरी १०० मिटर (100 meters) सम्म हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: लामो दूरीको सञ्चारका लागि उपयुक्त हुने र एउटा मात्र प्रकाश किरण प्रवाह गर्ने अप्टिकल फाइबर कुन हो?
question_english: Which type of optical fiber uses a narrow core (typically 8 to 10 microns) allowing only a single mode of light to propagate, ideal for long-distance telecommunications?
explanation:
Single-Mode Fiber (SMF) has a narrow core (9 µm) that eliminates modal dispersion, enabling laser pulses to travel tens of kilometers without repeaters.

नेपाली व्याख्या: सिंगल-मोड फाइबर (Single-Mode Fiber) ले प्रकाशको एउटा मात्र किरण पठाउने हुँदा लामो दूरीमा सिग्नल क्षय (Loss) न्यून हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: डेटा बिट्सलाई बाइनरी पोलिनोमिएल मानेर मोड्युलो-२ भाग (Modulo-2 division) मार्फत त्रुटि पत्ता लगाउने प्रविधि कुन हो?
question_english: Which error detection method relies on treating data bits as a binary polynomial and dividing them by a fixed generator polynomial using modulo-2 arithmetic?
explanation:
CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) uses modulo-2 polynomial division to generate a remainder (FCS) appended to data frames in Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and storage protocols.

नेपाली व्याख्या: CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) ले मोड्युलो-२ पोलिनोमिएल भाग विधि प्रयोग गरी नेटवर्कमा आएको त्रुटि पत्ता लगाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: ह्यामिङ कोड (Hamming Code) अन्य सामान्य त्रुटि जाँच प्रविधि भन्दा किन फरक र महत्त्वपूर्ण छ?
question_english: Hamming Code is unique among standard error handling techniques because it possesses the ability to:
options: Both detect single-bit errors and automatically correct them without retransmission
explanation:
Hamming code incorporates redundant parity check bits at positions of powers of 2, enabling both detection and localized correction of single-bit errors (SECDED).

नेपाली व्याख्या: ह्यामिङ कोडले डेटामा आएको एकल-बिट त्रुटि पत्ता लगाउनुका साथै पुनः नपठाई स्वचालित रूपमा सच्याउन सक्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: ४ बिट डाटा ($d=4$) को लागि ह्यामिङ कोड प्रयोग गर्दा सूत्र $2^p \ge d + p + 1$ अनुसार न्यूनतम कति प्यारिटी बिट ($p$) आवश्यक पर्दछ?
question_english: To protect 4 data bits ($d=4$) using a single-error-correcting Hamming Code, what is the minimum number of parity bits ($p$) required by the formula $2^p \ge d + p + 1$?
explanation:
For $d=4$: if $p=3$, $2^3 = 8 \ge 4 + 3 + 1 = 8$ (satisfies the inequality). Thus, 3 parity bits are required, creating a 7-bit codeword (7,4 Hamming code).

नेपाली व्याख्या: $d=4$ का लागि $p=3$ राख्दा $2^3 = 8 \ge 4 + 3 + 1 = 8$ सूत्र पूरा हुने भएकाले ३ वटा प्यारिटी बिट चाहिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: IPv4 र IPv6 ठेगानाहरूको कुल लम्बाइ क्रमशः कति बिट हुन्छ?
question_english: What is the total bit length of an IPv4 address and an IPv6 address respectively?
explanation:
IPv4 uses 32 bits (4 octets written in dotted-decimal), providing $\approx 4.3$ billion addresses. IPv6 uses 128 bits (8 hexadecimal groups), providing $3.4 \times 10^{38}$ addresses.

नेपाली व्याख्या: IPv4 ठेगाना ३२ बिट (32 bits) को हुन्छ भने IPv6 ठेगाना १२८ बिट (128 bits) को हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: मानक Class B IPv4 नेटवर्कको पूर्वनिर्धारित सबनेट मास्क (Default Subnet Mask) कुन हो?
question_english: What is the default subnet mask for a standard Class B IPv4 network?

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: `192.168.10.0/27` सबनेटमा कम्प्युटरहरूलाई वितरण गर्न मिल्ने प्रयोगयोग्य (Usable) IP ठेगाना कतिवटा हुन्छन्?
question_english: Given the CIDR notation `192.168.10.0/27`, how many usable host IP addresses can be assigned to computers on this subnet?
explanation:
A /27 subnet mask leaves $32 - 27 = 5$ host bits. Total IP addresses = $2^5 = 32$. Subtracting 2 for Network Address and Broadcast Address gives $32 - 2 = 30$ usable hosts.

नेपाली व्याख्या: /27 सबनेटमा ५ बिट होस्टका लागि बाँकी रहन्छ। कुल ३२ ठेगानाबाट नेटवर्क र ब्रोडकास्ट घटाउँदा ३० वटा प्रयोगयोग्य हुन्छन्।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: RFC 1918 अनुसार इन्टरनेटमा सिधै नचल्ने निजी (Private IP) ठेगाना दायरा कुन हो?
question_english: Which of the following IPv4 address ranges is designated as private, non-routable address space under RFC 1918?
explanation:
RFC 1918 sets aside Class A (10.0.0.0/8), Class B (172.16.0.0/12), and Class C (192.168.0.0/16) exclusively for internal private networks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: १०.x.x.x, १७२.१६.x.x देखि १७२.३१.x.x र १९२.१६८.x.x सबै निजी (Private) प्रयोजनका लागि सुरक्षित गरिएका IP हुन्।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: `127.0.0.1` (लुपब्याक ठेगाना) को मुख्य प्रयोग के हो?
question_english: What is the purpose of the loopback IP address `127.0.0.1` (`::1` in IPv6)?
options: To test connectivity to the default gateway
To test the internal TCP/IP network protocol stack on the local host without sending packets to the network card
To broadcast messages to all LAN nodes
To dynamically acquire an IP address from DHCP
explanation:
The loopback address (127.0.0.1) routes packets back to the local host's TCP/IP stack to test protocol functionality without hardware network traffic.

नेपाली व्याख्या: लुपब्याक ठेगानाले आफ्नै कम्प्युटरको TCP/IP प्रोटोकल स्ट्याक ठीकसँग काम गरिरहेको छ कि छैन भनी परीक्षण गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: सिमेट्रिक र असिमेट्रिक इन्क्रिप्सन बीचको मुख्य भिन्नता के हो?
question_english: What is the primary difference between Symmetric and Asymmetric encryption?
options: Symmetric uses two different keys; Asymmetric uses one shared key
Symmetric encryption uses the exact same single secret key for both encryption and decryption, whereas Asymmetric uses a mathematically linked public-private key pair
Asymmetric is much faster than symmetric
explanation:
Symmetric encryption (AES, DES) relies on one shared key for both operations. Asymmetric encryption (RSA, ECC) uses a public key to encrypt and a private key to decrypt.

नेपाली व्याख्या: सिमेट्रिकमा डेटा इन्क्रिप्ट र डिक्रिप्ट गर्न एउटै गोप्य साँचो (Key) प्रयोग हुन्छ भने असिमेट्रिकमा पब्लिक र प्राइभेट गरी दुईवटा साँचो हुन्छन्।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: बैंक तथा सरकारी निकायमा १२८, १९२ वा २५६ बिटको साँचो प्रयोग गरी डाटा सुरक्षित राख्न स्वीकृत मानक कुन हो?
question_english: Which symmetric encryption standard uses a 128, 192, or 256-bit block cipher key and is globally approved for securing enterprise banking and government data?
explanation:
AES (Advanced Encryption Standard / Rijndael) replaced vulnerable 56-bit DES and is the worldwide standard for high-speed symmetric data encryption in banking.

नेपाली व्याख्या: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) बैंकिङ तथा वित्तीय क्षेत्रमा प्रयोग गरिने अत्यधिक सुरक्षित इन्क्रिप्सन मानक हो।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर (Digital Signature) सिर्जना गर्दा प्रमाणीकरण र गैर-अस्वीकार्यताका लागि कुन साँचो प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: In public key cryptography, how is a 'Digital Signature' created to provide authentication and non-repudiation?
options: By encrypting the document hash with the Sender's Private Key
By encrypting the document with the Receiver's Public Key
By hashing the sender's IP address
explanation:
A digital signature is created by hashing the message and encrypting the digest using the Sender's Private Key. Anyone with the sender's public key can verify authenticity.

नेपाली व्याख्या: डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर सिर्जना गर्न म्यासेजको ह्यासलाई प्रेषकको आफ्नै प्राइभेट कि (Private Key) ले इन्क्रिप्ट गरिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: प्याकेटको हेडरका साथै चलिरहेको TCP/UDP जडानको अवस्था (State) समेत निगरानी गर्ने फायरवाल कुन हो?
question_english: What type of firewall inspects not only individual packet headers (IP, ports) but also monitors the operational state and context of active TCP/UDP connections?
explanation:
Stateful inspection firewalls track the state of network connections (SYN, ACK, established) and only allow incoming packets that match legitimate active outgoing sessions.

नेपाली व्याख्या: स्टेटफुल इन्स्पेक्सन फायरवालले सक्रिय नेटवर्क कनेक्सनको अवस्था सम्झेर अनधिकृत बाह्य प्याकेटहरूलाई ब्लक गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: Class C को सामान्य नेटवर्कमा अधिकतम कतिवटा कम्प्युटर (Hosts) जोड्न सकिन्छ?
question_english: What is the maximum number of network hosts possible on a single unsubnetted Class C IPv4 network with default mask `255.255.255.0`?
explanation:
Class C has 8 host bits. $2^8 = 256$ total addresses. Minus 2 (network and broadcast) leaves 254 assignable host addresses.

नेपाली व्याख्या: Class C मा ८ बिट होस्टका लागि हुने भएकाले २५६ - २ = २५४ वटा कम्प्युटर जोड्न सकिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: २५६ बिटको निश्चित लम्बाइ भएको सुरक्षित र एकतर्फी (One-way) ह्यास उत्पन्न गर्ने एल्गोरिदम कुन हो?
question_english: Which cryptographic hash algorithm produces a 256-bit fixed-length output and is mathematically considered one-way and collision-resistant?
explanation:
SHA-256 generates a 256-bit (32-byte) cryptographic digest used in TLS certificates, blockchain mining, and digital banking integrity verification.

नेपाली व्याख्या: SHA-256 ले कुनै पनि साइजको डेटाबाट २५६ बिटको अद्वितीय डिजिटल औंठाछाप (Digest) तयार गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: इन्टरप्राइज नेटवर्क स्विचिङमा 'VLAN' को पूर्ण रूप के हो?
question_english: What does the acronym 'VLAN' stand for in enterprise network switching?
explanation:
A Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) logically partitions a physical Layer 2 switch network into isolated broadcast domains for security and traffic control.

नेपाली व्याख्या: VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network) ले एउटै भौतिक स्विच भित्र विभिन्न विभागहरूका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै भर्चुअल नेटवर्क बनाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: कम्प्युटर सुरु हुनासाथ UDP पोर्ट ६७/६८ प्रयोग गरी स्वचालित IP दिने प्रोटोकल कुन हो?
question_english: Which network protocol runs over UDP ports 67/68 to assign IP configurations dynamically upon client boot?
explanation:
DHCP operates over UDP port 67 (server) and 68 (client) through the DORA process (Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge).

नेपाली व्याख्या: DHCP ले UDP पोर्ट ६७ र ६८ मार्फत DORA प्रक्रियाबाट कम्प्युटरलाई IP उपलब्ध गराउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Computer Networking, Switching, Protocols & Security
question_nepali: OSI मोडलमा दुई प्रणाली बीच संवाद (Session) स्थापना, व्यवस्थापन र अन्त्य गर्ने जिम्मेवारी कुन तहको हो?
question_english: In the OSI reference model, which layer is responsible for establishing, managing, and terminating dialogue sessions between applications across nodes?
explanation:
The Session Layer (Layer 5) manages dialogues, synchronization checkpoints, and connection establishment/teardown between applications.

नेपाली व्याख्या: सेसन लेयर (Layer 5) ले सञ्चार गरिरहेका दुई यन्त्रहरू बीच संवाद कायम राख्न र सिन्क्रोनाइज गर्न मद्दत गर्दछ।

नेपाली व्याख्या: सेसन लेयर (Layer 5) ले सञ्चार गरिरहेका दुई यन्त्रहरू बीच संवाद कायम राख्न र सिन्क्रोनाइज गर्न मद्दत गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: कुन CPU शेड्युलिङ एल्गोरिदम नन-प्रिएम्प्टिभ हुन्छ र सबैभन्दा छोटो अनुमानित कार्यान्वयन समय भएको प्रक्रिया छनोट गर्दछ?
question_english: Which CPU scheduling algorithm is non-preemptive and selects the process with the smallest anticipated execution time?
explanation:
Non-preemptive SJF schedules the process with the shortest CPU burst time, provably minimizing average waiting time for a given set of processes.

नेपाली व्याख्या: SJF (Shortest Job First) ले सबैभन्दा कम समय लिने कामलाई पहिले सम्पन्न गर्दछ, जसले औसत प्रतिक्षा समय (Waiting Time) घटाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: राउन्ड रोबिन शेड्युलिङमा टाइम क्वान्टम (Time Quantum) अत्यधिक ठूलो बनाइयो भने यसको व्यवहार कस्तो हुन्छ?
question_english: In Round Robin CPU scheduling, what happens if the time quantum allocated to processes is set excessively large?
options: It degenerates into First-Come, First-Served (FCFS) scheduling
It behaves like Shortest Remaining Time First
explanation:
If the time quantum exceeds the longest CPU burst, every process completes in its first slice without preemption, degenerating into FCFS.

नेपाली व्याख्या: टाइम क्वान्टम धेरै ठूलो राखिएमा राउन्ड रोबिन प्रणाली FCFS (First-Come, First-Served) मा परिणत हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: अपरेटिङ सिस्टमले प्रत्येक सक्रिय प्रक्रियाको अवस्था र रजिस्टरहरू सुरक्षित राख्न कुन डेटा संरचना प्रयोग गर्दछ?
question_english: What data structure does the operating system maintain for each active process to store its execution state, program counter, and CPU registers?
explanation:
The Process Control Block (PCB / task struct) contains PID, process state, program counter, CPU registers, scheduling priority, and open file descriptors.

नेपाली व्याख्या: PCB (Process Control Block) मा प्रक्रियाको आइडी, अवस्था, मेमोरी सिमा र दर्ताहरू सुरक्षित हुन्छन्।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: डेडलक (Deadlock) हुनका लागि आवश्यक चारवटा कफम्यान सर्तहरू मध्ये कुन होइन?
question_english: Which of the following is NOT one of the four necessary Coffman conditions required for a deadlock to occur?
explanation:
'No Preemption' (resources cannot be forcibly confiscated) is the required deadlock condition. Preemption actually prevents or breaks deadlocks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: डेडलकका लागि 'No Preemption' (खोस्न नपाइने) सर्त हुनुपर्दछ, प्रिएम्प्सन भएमा डेडलक हुँदैन।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: स्रोतको माग पूरा गर्नु अगावै प्रणाली सुरक्षित अवस्था (Safe State) मा रहन्छ कि रहँदैन भनी जाँच्ने प्रसिद्ध डेडलक निवारण एल्गोरिदम कुन हो?
question_english: Which classic deadlock avoidance algorithm tests for safety by simulating the allocation of predetermined maximum possible resources before granting requests?
explanation:
Dijkstra's Banker's Algorithm simulates resource allocation to ensure the system remains in a safe state where at least one execution sequence can terminate.

नेपाली व्याख्या: डिक्सट्राको ब्याङ्कर्स एल्गोरिदम (Banker's Algorithm) ले प्रणालीलाई असुरक्षित अवस्था र डेडलकबाट जोगाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: युनिक्स/लिनक्समा चलिरहेको प्रक्रियाको हुबहु नक्कल गरी नयाँ चाइल्ड प्रोसेस बनाउने सिस्टम कल कुन हो?
question_english: In UNIX/Linux systems, which system call creates a new duplicate child process by duplicating the calling process's address space?
explanation:
The `fork()` system call creates an identical child process with a unique PID, returning 0 to the child and the child's PID to the parent.

नेपाली व्याख्या: `fork()` सिस्टम कलले नयाँ चाइल्ड प्रोसेस सिर्जना गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: लिनक्समा चलिरहेका प्रक्रियाहरूको CPU र मेमोरी उपयोगिता निरन्तर ताजा देखाउने कमान्ड कुन हो?
question_english: Which Linux command displays active processes and dynamically updates their CPU and real-time memory utilization every few seconds?
explanation:
The `top` command provides a dynamic, real-time interactive view of system processes, sorting tasks by CPU and memory consumption.

नेपाली व्याख्या: `top` कमान्डले लिनक्समा वास्तविक समयमा स्रोतहरूको खपत र प्रक्रियाहरू देखाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: लिनक्समा फाइलको मालिकलाई पूर्ण अधिकार (Read/Write/Execute) र अरूलाई पढ्ने मात्र अधिकार (`rwxr--r--`) दिन कुन अङ्क प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: What octal numeric mode represents read, write, and execute permissions for the owner, and read-only permissions for group and others (`rwxr--r--`) in Linux?
explanation:
Owner: rwx = 4+2+1 = 7. Group: r-- = 4+0+0 = 4. Others: r-- = 4+0+0 = 4. Total octal permission is 744.

नेपाली व्याख्या: मालिकका लागि ७ (rwx) र समूह तथा अरूका लागि ४ (r--) गर्दा अक्टल मान ७४४ (744) हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: दुई वा सोभन्दा बढी प्रक्रियाहरू बीच स्रोतको बाँडफाँड मिलाउन डिक्सट्राले प्रतिपादन गरेको इन्टिजर काउन्टर कुन हो?
question_english: Which inter-process synchronization primitive invented by Edsger Dijkstra uses integer counters accessed atomically via `wait()` ($P$) and `signal()` ($V$) operations?
explanation:
A counting semaphore uses an integer value that is decremented atomically by `wait()` and incremented by `signal()`, synchronizing access to a finite pool of resources.

नेपाली व्याख्या: काउन्टिङ सेमाफोर (Counting Semaphore) ले प्रक्रियाहरू बीच स्रोतहरूको सुरक्षित साझेदारी सुनिश्चित गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: आवश्यकता भन्दा बढी डेटा स्ट्याकमा पठाएर रिटर्न ठेगाना ओभरराइट गरी अनधिकृत कोड चलाउने कमजोरीलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: What memory vulnerability occurs when an application writes more data to a buffer on the call stack than was allocated, potentially overwriting the instruction pointer?
explanation:
A stack buffer overflow overwrites adjacent memory spaces (including the saved EIP/RIP return address), allowing attackers to execute arbitrary shellcode.

नेपाली व्याख्या: बफर ओभरफ्लो (Buffer Overflow) ले मेमोरीको सीमा भन्दा बढी डेटा लेखेर प्रणालीलाई नियन्त्रणमा लिन मद्दत गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: लिनक्समा कुनै नरोकिएको प्रक्रियालाई तुरुन्तै जबर्जस्ती बन्द गर्न कुन कमान्ड प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which Linux command is used to terminate an unresponsive process with a forceful, uncatchable termination signal (`SIGKILL`)?
explanation:
`kill -9` sends SIGKILL (signal 9), which cannot be caught, blocked, or ignored by the process, forcing the kernel to terminate it immediately.

नेपाली व्याख्या: `kill -9` कमान्डले SIGKILL सिग्नल पठाएर कुनै पनि प्रक्रियालाई तत्काल नष्ट गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: मल्टिटास्किङ अपरेटिङ सिस्टममा 'सर्ट-टर्म शेड्युलिङ' (Short-Term Scheduler) को मुख्य जिम्मेवारी के हो?
question_english: In modern multi-tasking operating systems, what is the role of the 'Short-Term Scheduler' (CPU Scheduler)?
options: Loads programs from disk into main memory
Selects from ready processes in memory and allocates the CPU to one of them
explanation:
The short-term scheduler (dispatcher) executes frequently (milliseconds) to select which in-memory ready process runs on the CPU next.

नेपाली व्याख्या: सर्ट-टर्म शेड्युलरले मेमोरीमा तयार रहेका प्रक्रियाहरू मध्येबाट एउटालाई छानेर CPU सुम्पिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: विन्डोज सर्भरमा सुरक्षा, जर्नालिङ र इन्क्रिप्सनका लागि प्रयोग गरिने मानक फाइल प्रणाली कुन हो?
question_english: Which file system is standard on modern enterprise Windows Server editions, providing file permissions, journaling, and transparent encryption?
explanation:
NTFS supports access control lists (ACLs), file compression, transaction journaling for crash recovery, and Encrypting File System (EFS).

नेपाली व्याख्या: NTFS ले विन्डोजमा फाइल अनुमति, सुरक्षा र प्रणाली क्र्यास हुँदा डेटा जोगाउने जर्नालिङ सुविधा दिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: मेमोरी व्यवस्थापनमा 'बाह्य खण्डीकरण' (External Fragmentation) ले के जनाउँछ?
question_english: In operating system memory virtualization, what is 'External Fragmentation'?
options: Wasted space inside a fixed-size partition allocated to a small process
Total free memory space is sufficient to satisfy a request, but it is non-contiguous and cannot be allocated
explanation:
External fragmentation happens in dynamic variable-partition allocation where free memory is broken into tiny non-contiguous blocks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: पर्याप्त कुल खाली मेमोरी भए पनि त्यो एकमुष्ठ (Contiguous) नभएर टुक्रा-टुक्रा परेको अवस्था बाह्य खण्डीकरण हो।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security

question_nepali: विन्डोज सर्भरमा सुरक्षा, जर्नालिङ र इन्क्रिप्सनका लागि प्रयोग गरिने मानक फाइल प्रणाली कुन हो?
question_english: Which file system is standard on modern enterprise Windows Server editions, providing file permissions, journaling, and transparent encryption?
explanation:

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: मेमोरी व्यवस्थापनमा 'बाह्य खण्डीकरण' (External Fragmentation) ले के जनाउँछ?
question_english: In operating system memory virtualization, what is 'External Fragmentation'?
options: Wasted space inside a fixed-size partition allocated to a small process
Total free memory space is sufficient to satisfy a request, but it is non-contiguous and cannot be allocated
explanation:
External fragmentation happens in dynamic variable-partition allocation where free memory is broken into tiny non-contiguous blocks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: पर्याप्त कुल खाली मेमोरी भए पनि त्यो एकमुष्ठ (Contiguous) नभएर टुक्रा-टुक्रा परेको अवस्था बाह्य खण्डीकरण हो।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: लिनक्समा कुनै नरोकिएको प्रक्रियालाई तुरुन्तै जबर्जस्ती बन्द गर्न कुन कमान्ड प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which Linux command is used to terminate an unresponsive process with a forceful, uncatchable termination signal (`SIGKILL`)?
explanation:
`kill -9` sends SIGKILL (signal 9), which cannot be caught, blocked, or ignored by the process, forcing the kernel to terminate it immediately.

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: मल्टिटास्किङ अपरेटिङ सिस्टममा 'सर्ट-टर्म शेड्युलिङ' (Short-Term Scheduler) को मुख्य जिम्मेवारी के हो?
question_english: In modern multi-tasking operating systems, what is the role of the 'Short-Term Scheduler' (CPU Scheduler)?
options: Loads programs from disk into main memory
Selects from ready processes in memory and allocates the CPU to one of them
explanation:
The short-term scheduler (dispatcher) executes frequently (milliseconds) to select which in-memory ready process runs on the CPU next.

question_nepali: लिनक्समा कुनै नरोकिएको प्रक्रियालाई तुरुन्तै जबर्जस्ती बन्द गर्न कुन कमान्ड प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which Linux command is used to terminate an unresponsive process with a forceful, uncatchable termination signal (`SIGKILL`)?
explanation:
`kill -9` sends SIGKILL (signal 9), which cannot be caught, blocked, or ignored by the process, forcing the kernel to terminate it immediately.

नेपाली व्याख्या: `kill -9` कमान्डले SIGKILL सिग्नल पठाएर कुनै पनि प्रक्रियालाई तत्काल नष्ट गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: मल्टिटास्किङ अपरेटिङ सिस्टममा 'सर्ट-टर्म शेड्युलिङ' (Short-Term Scheduler) को मुख्य जिम्मेवारी के हो?
question_english: In modern multi-tasking operating systems, what is the role of the 'Short-Term Scheduler' (CPU Scheduler)?
options: Loads programs from disk into main memory
Selects from ready processes in memory and allocates the CPU to one of them
explanation:
The short-term scheduler (dispatcher) executes frequently (milliseconds) to select which in-memory ready process runs on the CPU next.

नेपाली व्याख्या: सर्ट-टर्म शेड्युलरले मेमोरीमा तयार रहेका प्रक्रियाहरू मध्येबाट एउटालाई छानेर CPU सुम्पिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: विन्डोज सर्भरमा सुरक्षा, जर्नालिङ र इन्क्रिप्सनका लागि प्रयोग गरिने मानक फाइल प्रणाली कुन हो?
question_english: Which file system is standard on modern enterprise Windows Server editions, providing file permissions, journaling, and transparent encryption?
explanation:
NTFS supports access control lists (ACLs), file compression, transaction journaling for crash recovery, and Encrypting File System (EFS).

नेपाली व्याख्या: NTFS ले विन्डोजमा फाइल अनुमति, सुरक्षा र प्रणाली क्र्यास हुँदा डेटा जोगाउने जर्नालिङ सुविधा दिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 4: Operating System, Process Management & Security
question_nepali: मेमोरी व्यवस्थापनमा 'बाह्य खण्डीकरण' (External Fragmentation) ले के जनाउँछ?
question_english: In operating system memory virtualization, what is 'External Fragmentation'?
options: Wasted space inside a fixed-size partition allocated to a small process
Total free memory space is sufficient to satisfy a request, but it is non-contiguous and cannot be allocated
explanation:
External fragmentation happens in dynamic variable-partition allocation where free memory is broken into tiny non-contiguous blocks.

नेपाली व्याख्या: पर्याप्त कुल खाली मेमोरी भए पनि त्यो एकमुष्ठ (Contiguous) नभएर टुक्रा-टुक्रा परेको अवस्था बाह्य खण्डीकरण हो।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: सम्बन्धात्मक डेटाबेसमा विदेशी साँचो (Foreign Key) ले प्यारेन्ट टेबलको प्राथमिक साँचोसँग मेल खानुपर्ने वा खाली हुनुपर्ने नियमलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: In relational database design, which property enforces that a foreign key value must either match an existing primary key in the referenced parent table or be null?
explanation:
Referential integrity guarantees that relationships between tables remain consistent, preventing orphan child records.

नेपाली व्याख्या: रेफरेन्सियल इन्टिग्रिटी (Referential Integrity) ले दुई टेबल बीचको सम्बन्धलाई मान्य र एकरूप राख्न मद्दत गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: डेटाबेस टेबलमा प्राथमिक साँचो (Primary Key) को रूपमा नछानिएको अन्य सम्भावित साँचोलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: A candidate key that is not chosen to be the primary key of a relational table is formally called a(n):
explanation:
Candidate keys are minimal superkeys capable of uniquely identifying rows. The one not picked as primary is termed an alternate key.

नेपाली व्याख्या: प्राइमरी कि बाहेकका अन्य उम्मेदवार साँचोहरूलाई अल्टरनेट कि (Alternate Key) भनिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: कुनै रिलेसनल टेबल 1NF मा भएर दोस्रो सामान्यीकरण फारम (2NF) मा हुन कुन सर्त पूरा गर्नुपर्दछ?
question_english: A relational database table is in Second Normal Form (2NF) if and only if it is in 1NF and satisfies which condition?
options: Every non-prime attribute is fully functionally dependent on the entire primary key (no partial dependency)
Every determinant is a candidate key
explanation:
2NF eliminates partial dependencies, requiring every non-key attribute to depend on the whole composite primary key, not just a subset.

नेपाली व्याख्या: 2NF मा हुनका लागि कम्पोजिट प्राइमरी कि को कुनै एउटा भागमा मात्र निर्भर हुने आंशिक निर्भरता (Partial Dependency) हटाइनुपर्छ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: कुनै गैर-प्रमुख विशेषता अर्को गैर-प्रमुख विशेषतामा निर्भर हुने ट्रान्जिटिभ निर्भरता हटाउने नर्मल फर्म कुन हो?
question_english: Which normal form strictly eliminates transitive functional dependencies ($X \to Y$ and $Y \to Z$ where $Z$ is non-prime)?
explanation:
3NF requires a relation to be in 2NF and contain no transitive dependencies, meaning non-prime attributes must depend only on candidate keys.

नेपाली व्याख्या: तेस्रो सामान्यीकरण फारम (3NF) ले ट्रान्जिटिभ निर्भरता (Transitive Dependency) हटाएर डेटा दोहोरिन रोक्छ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: डेटाबेस ट्रान्ज्याक्सनको ACID गुणहरूमा 'I' (Isolation) ले के ग्यारेन्टी गर्दछ?
question_english: In database transaction management, what does the 'I' in ACID properties guarantee?
options: Integrity of data across foreign keys
Concurrent execution of transactions results in a system state as if transactions were executed serially without interfering with one another
explanation:
Isolation ensures that uncommitted intermediate states of a transaction are invisible to other concurrently executing transactions.

नेपाली व्याख्या: आइसोलेसन (Isolation) ले एकैपटक धेरै कारोबार हुँदा एउटाको नतिजा नसकिँदासम्म अर्कोलाई प्रभाव पार्न नदिने सुनिश्चित गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: SQL मा `GROUP BY` द्वारा बनाइएको समूहलाई एग्रिगेट सर्तका आधारमा फिल्टर गर्न कुन शब्द प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which SQL clause is used to filter groups formed by the `GROUP BY` statement based on aggregate conditions (e.g., `COUNT(*) > 5`)?
explanation:
`WHERE` filters individual rows before grouping, whereas `HAVING` filters aggregated groups after grouping.

नेपाली व्याख्या: `HAVING` क्लजले एग्रिगेट मानहरू (जस्तै SUM, COUNT) का आधारमा समूहहरूलाई फिल्टर गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: बायाँ टेबलका सबै रेकर्डहरू र दायाँ टेबलका मेल खाने रेकर्डहरू ल्याउने SQL JOIN कुन हो?
question_english: Which type of SQL JOIN returns all rows from the left table and the matched rows from the right table, filling nulls if no match is found?
explanation:
A LEFT OUTER JOIN preserves all rows from the left table regardless of whether a matching record exists in the right table.

नेपाली व्याख्या: LEFT JOIN ले बायाँ टेबलका सम्पूर्ण डेटा र दायाँ टेबलबाट मेल खाने डेटा मात्र प्रदर्शन गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: OLTP र OLAP प्रणाली बीचको मुख्य भिन्नता के हो?
question_english: What is the primary difference between OLTP (Online Transaction Processing) and OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) systems?
options: OLTP is read-only; OLAP is write-heavy
OLTP focuses on fast, atomic daily operational transactions (normalized), while OLAP focuses on complex historical queries and decision support (denormalized multidimensional models)
OLTP uses star schemas; OLAP uses flat files
OLTP is only used in cloud environments
explanation:
OLTP (Core Banking) handles real-time inserts/updates with high normalization. OLAP (Data Warehouse) handles read-intensive multidimensional analytics for executive reporting.

नेपाली व्याख्या: OLTP दैनिक कारोबार (जस्तै पैसा झिक्ने/जम्मा गर्ने) का लागि हो भने OLAP ऐतिहासिक डेटा विश्लेषण र निर्णय प्रक्रियाका लागि हो।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: डेटा वेयरहाउसमा संख्यात्मक कारोबार परिमाण (Metrics) र डाइमेन्सनका साँचोहरू राख्ने मुख्य टेबल कुन हो?
question_english: In a Data Warehouse dimensional model, which table contains foreign keys referencing dimensions along with numerical, measurable metrics (e.g., transaction amount, quantity)?
explanation:
A Fact Table stores the quantitative measurements (facts) and foreign keys connecting to descriptive dimension tables (e.g., Date, Customer, Branch).

नेपाली व्याख्या: फ्याक्ट टेबल (Fact Table) मा वास्तविक वित्तीय कारोबारका संख्यात्मक मानहरू र डाइमेन्सन किहरू सुरक्षित हुन्छन्।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: डेटा वेयरहाउसमा डेटा एकीकृत गर्ने मानक प्रक्रिया (ETL) को सही क्रम कुन हो?
question_english: What is the correct sequence of phases in the standard enterprise data warehousing integration workflow?
explanation:
ETL extracts raw data from multiple operational sources, cleanses/transforms it to a uniform format, and loads it into the data warehouse.

नेपाली व्याख्या: ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) ले विभिन्न स्रोतबाट डेटा संकलन गरी, प्रशोधन गरेर वेयरहाउसमा भण्डारण गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: विपद् व्यवस्थापन (DRP) मा वास्तविक समयमै डेटा दोहोरिने र केही मिनेटमै बैंकिङ कारोबार सुचारु गर्न सक्ने पूर्ण तयारी अवस्थाको साइट कुन हो?
question_english: In disaster recovery planning, what type of secondary recovery site is fully configured with live mirrored hardware, real-time data replication, and can take over banking operations within minutes?
explanation:
A Hot Site is a fully operational, near-instantaneous mirror site with synchronized live data, offering the lowest RTO and RPO.

नेपाली व्याख्या: हट साइट (Hot Site) मा २४सै घण्टा वास्तविक समयको डेटा र सर्भर चालु अवस्थामा रहन्छ, जसले तत्कालै ब्याकअप दिन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: बैंकको BCP/DRP योजनामा RTO (Recovery Time Objective) ले के समय सीमा निर्धारण गर्दछ?
question_english: What does RTO (Recovery Time Objective) define in a bank's Business Continuity Management (BCM) plan?
options: The maximum acceptable duration of system downtime before financial services must be restored
The maximum age of backup files that can be recovered without financial penalty
The mean time between two hardware crashes
The network ping time to the primary database
explanation:
RTO is the maximum targeted elapsed time allowed to restore a business process or IT service after a disaster.

नेपाली व्याख्या: RTO भनेको प्रणाली बन्द भएपछि कति समय भित्र सेवा पुनः सञ्चालन गरिसक्नु पर्दछ भन्ने अधिकतम समय सीमा हो।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: XML कागजातको संरचना र डेटा प्रकारको वैधता जाँच्न कुन प्रविधि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: In XML documents, what mechanism provides a schema definition language to validate document structure, data types, and element constraints?
explanation:
An XSD (XML Schema Definition) defines the allowed elements, attributes, data types, and hierarchy of an XML document.

नेपाली व्याख्या: XSD (XML Schema Definition) ले XML फाइलको नियम र संरचना सही छ कि छैन भनी प्रमाणित गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: बैंकको वेब सर्भर अगाडि राखिने 'रिभर्स प्रोक्सी' (Reverse Proxy) को मुख्य कार्य के हो?
question_english: What is a 'Reverse Proxy' server commonly deployed in front of bank web application servers?
options: Hides client internal IP addresses from the web
Intercepts inbound client requests to provide SSL termination, load balancing, and DDoS mitigation for internal backend servers
explanation:
A reverse proxy acts as an intermediary for external clients, distributing traffic across backend servers while shielding direct backend server IP addresses.

नेपाली व्याख्या: रिभर्स प्रोक्सीले बाह्य ग्राहकहरूको अनुरोध लिएर लोड ब्यालेन्सिङ र सुरक्षा प्रदान गर्दै मुख्य सर्भरलाई सुरक्षित राख्छ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: डेटाबेस क्र्यास हुँदा छिटो रिकभर गर्न सबै अस्थायी डेटालाई डिस्कमा लेख्ने कार्यलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: In database recovery management, what technique periodically flushes all modified dirty cache buffers to disk and writes a sync record to the log to minimize crash recovery time?
explanation:
Checkpoints establish a synchronized state where all logs and memory buffers prior to the checkpoint are committed to physical disk, bounding recovery replay time.

नेपाली व्याख्या: चेकपोइन्टिङ (Checkpointing) ले मेमोरीमा रहेको डेटालाई डिस्कमा सुरक्षित गरी क्र्यास भएपछि पुनः सुरु हुने समय घटाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: डेटाबेस प्रयोगकर्तालाई दिइएको अधिकार फिर्ता लिन कुन DCL कमान्ड प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which SQL command belongs to the Data Control Language (DCL) used to revoke previously granted database privileges from a database user?
explanation:
`REVOKE` is a DCL statement that removes access permissions (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE) previously granted to roles or users.

नेपाली व्याख्या: `REVOKE` कमान्डले डेटाबेस प्रयोगकर्तालाई पहिले दिइएको पहुँच अधिकार खोस्ने काम गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: XML कागजातको संरचना र डेटा प्रकारको वैधता जाँच्न कुन प्रविधि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?

question_nepali: डेटाबेस प्रयोगकर्तालाई दिइएको अधिकार फिर्ता लिन कुन DCL कमान्ड प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: Which SQL command belongs to the Data Control Language (DCL) used to revoke previously granted database privileges from a database user?
explanation:
`REVOKE` is a DCL statement that removes access permissions (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE) previously granted to roles or users.

नेपाली व्याख्या: `REVOKE` कमान्डले डेटाबेस प्रयोगकर्तालाई पहिले दिइएको पहुँच अधिकार खोस्ने काम गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: XML कागजातको संरचना र डेटा प्रकारको वैधता जाँच्न कुन प्रविधि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
question_english: In XML documents, what mechanism provides a schema definition language to validate document structure, data types, and element constraints?
explanation:
An XSD (XML Schema Definition) defines the allowed elements, attributes, data types, and hierarchy of an XML document.

नेपाली व्याख्या: XSD (XML Schema Definition) ले XML फाइलको नियम र संरचना सही छ कि छैन भनी प्रमाणित गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: बैंकको वेब सर्भर अगाडि राखिने 'रिभर्स प्रोक्सी' (Reverse Proxy) को मुख्य कार्य के हो?
question_english: What is a 'Reverse Proxy' server commonly deployed in front of bank web application servers?
options: Hides client internal IP addresses from the web
Intercepts inbound client requests to provide SSL termination, load balancing, and DDoS mitigation for internal backend servers
explanation:
A reverse proxy acts as an intermediary for external clients, distributing traffic across backend servers while shielding direct backend server IP addresses.

नेपाली व्याख्या: रिभर्स प्रोक्सीले बाह्य ग्राहकहरूको अनुरोध लिएर लोड ब्यालेन्सिङ र सुरक्षा प्रदान गर्दै मुख्य सर्भरलाई सुरक्षित राख्छ।

unit_title: Unit 5: DBMS, SQL, Data Warehousing, Web Tech & DRP
question_nepali: डेटाबेस क्र्यास हुँदा छिटो रिकभर गर्न सबै अस्थायी डेटालाई डिस्कमा लेख्ने कार्यलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: In database recovery management, what technique periodically flushes all modified dirty cache buffers to disk and writes a sync record to the log to minimize crash recovery time?
explanation:
Checkpoints establish a synchronized state where all logs and memory buffers prior to the checkpoint are committed to physical disk, bounding recovery replay time.

नेपाली व्याख्या: चेकपोइन्टिङ (Checkpointing) ले मेमोरीमा रहेको डेटालाई डिस्कमा सुरक्षित गरी क्र्यास भएपछि पुनः सुरु हुने समय घटाउँछ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: अनधिकृत व्यक्तिले बैंक रकमान्तरको विवरण बीचमै परिवर्तन गर्दा CIA ट्रायडको कुन सिद्धान्त उल्लंघन हुन्छ?
question_english: Which principle of the CIA Triad is violated when an unauthorized attacker intercepts and modifies the balance figure in an electronic bank fund transfer?
explanation:
Integrity ensures that information is accurate, complete, and protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.

नेपाली व्याख्या: इन्टिग्रिटी (Integrity) ले डेटा अनधिकृत रूपमा परिवर्तन नभएको र पूर्ण रूपमा शुद्ध रहेको सुनिश्चित गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: पहुँच नियन्त्रणमा प्रमाणीकरण (Authentication) र अख्तियारी (Authorization) बीचको मुख्य भिन्नता के हो?
question_english: What is the key difference between Authentication and Authorization in access control systems?
options: Authentication verifies identity ('Who you are'); Authorization verifies permissions ('What you are allowed to do')
Authentication uses access control lists, while authorization uses passwords
explanation:
Authentication validates the claim of an identity (e.g., via password/biometric). Authorization determines the privileges and resources granted to that authenticated identity.

नेपाली व्याख्या: Authentication ले प्रयोगकर्ता को हो भनी चिन्छ भने Authorization ले उसलाई के-के काम गर्ने अनुमति छ भनी तोक्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: कर्मचारीको व्यक्तिगत परिचयको सट्टा उसको पद र भूमिकाका आधारमा प्रणालीको पहुँच दिने मोडल कुन हो?
question_english: Which access control model assigns permissions based on an employee's organizational job function or role rather than individual user identities?
explanation:
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) simplifies administration in banks by granting permissions to roles (e.g., Teller, Loan Officer, Manager) and assigning users to roles.

नेपाली व्याख्या: RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) मा पद अनुसार अधिकार तोकिन्छ, जसले गर्दा बैंकिङ प्रणालीको व्यवस्थापन सहज हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: संस्थाका उच्च अधिकारीहरू (CEO, CFO) लाई लक्षित गरी गरिने विशेष प्रकारको फिसिङ आक्रमणलाई के भनिन्छ?
question_english: Which social engineering attack specifically targets high-ranking executives (CEOs, CFOs) with highly customized, fraudulent electronic communications?
explanation:
Whaling is a targeted phishing attack directed at C-level executives to authorize fraudulent wire transfers or disclose sensitive corporate secrets.

नेपाली व्याख्या: ह्वेलिङ (Whaling) भनेको संस्थाका उच्च नेतृत्व र कार्यकारीलाई झुक्याएर गरिने परिष्कृत फिसिङ आक्रमण हो।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: विश्वभरका संक्रमित कम्प्युटर वा क्यामराहरूको बोटनेट प्रयोग गरी बैंकिङ वेबसाइटलाई बन्द गराउने आक्रमण कुन हो?
question_english: What type of cyberattack floods an online banking portal with an overwhelming volume of synthetic traffic from a distributed network of compromised IoT/zombie devices (botnet)?
explanation:
A Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack overwhelms targeted servers or network bandwidth with botnet traffic, making the service unavailable to legitimate customers.

नेपाली व्याख्या: DDoS आक्रमणले एकैपटक लाखौं नक्कली अनुरोध पठाएर बैंकको अनलाइन सेवालाई ठप्प पार्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: प्रयोगकर्ताले फर्ममा भरेको विवरणलाई सिधै डेटाबेस क्वेरीमा राख्दा उत्पन्न हुने गम्भीर सुरक्षा कमजोरी कुन हो?
question_english: What web vulnerability occurs when an application includes untrusted user input directly in an SQL query without proper parameterization or prepared statements?
explanation:
SQL Injection allows attackers to manipulate backend database queries, bypass authentication, extract customer tables, or drop database records.

नेपाली व्याख्या: SQL इन्जेक्सन (SQLi) मार्फत ह्याकरले डेटाबेसका संवेदनशील रेकर्डहरू चोर्न वा परिवर्तन गर्न सक्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको Cyber Resilience Guidelines 2023 अनुसार वाणिज्य बैंकहरूले २४सै घण्टा साइबर सुरक्षा निगरानीका लागि के स्थापना गर्नुपर्दछ?
question_english: According to the Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) Cyber Resilience Guidelines 2023, every licensed commercial bank must establish which functional body for 24/7 security monitoring?
explanation:
Section 4 of the guidelines mandates that banks must establish or outsource a 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) equipped with SIEM capabilities for continuous threat detection.

नेपाली व्याख्या: NRB को निर्देशिका अनुसार बैंकहरूले २४/७ सुरक्षा निगरानी गर्न अनिवार्य रूपमा SOC (Security Operations Center) सञ्चालन गर्नुपर्छ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: NRB को Cyber Resilience Guidelines 2023 अनुसार कुनै गम्भीर साइबर सुरक्षा घटना घटेमा बैंकहरूले राष्ट्र बैंकलाई कति समय भित्र जानकारी गराउनुपर्छ?
question_english: Under NRB Cyber Resilience Guidelines 2023, licensed financial institutions must report any critical cyber security incident to NRB within what timeframe?
options: At the end of the fiscal month
explanation:
The guidelines require licensed institutions to provide prompt initial notification to NRB's IT/Payment Department within 24 hours of detecting a critical cyber incident.

नेपाली व्याख्या: कुनै गम्भीर साइबर आक्रमण भएमा बैंकले २४ घण्टा भित्र नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकलाई प्रारम्भिक जानकारी गराउनु पर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको IT निर्देशिका अनुसार बैंकहरूले आफ्नो मुख्य बैंकिङ प्रणालीमा कति अवधिमा VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing) गराउनुपर्छ?
question_english: According to NRB IT Guidelines, how often must commercial banks conduct Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) on their mission-critical banking infrastructure?
explanation:
NRB IT Guidelines mandate that commercial banks must conduct comprehensive VAPT assessments on critical systems at least twice a year (semi-annually) through certified third-party auditors.

नेपाली व्याख्या: बैंकहरूले वर्षको कम्तीमा दुई पटक (प्रत्येक ६ महिनामा) स्वतन्त्र विज्ञ मार्फत VAPT परीक्षण गराउनुपर्ने व्यवस्था छ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: विद्युतीय कारोबार ऐन, २०६३ को दफा ४४ अनुसार कम्प्युटर प्रणालीमा अनधिकृत पहुँच (ह्याकिङ) गरेमा कस्तो सजाय हुने व्यवस्था छ?
question_english: Under Chapter 9 of Nepal's Electronic Transactions Act (ETA) 2063, what is the maximum punishment for unauthorized access or hacking into a computer system with criminal intent?
options: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine up to Rs. 200,000, or both
explanation:
Section 44 of ETA 2063 prescribes imprisonment not exceeding three years or a fine not exceeding two hundred thousand rupees, or both, for illegal computer intrusion/hacking.

नेपाली व्याख्या: विद्युतीय कारोबार ऐन २०६३ अनुसार अनधिकृत पहुँच पुर्‍याएमा ३ वर्षसम्म कैद वा २ लाख रुपैयाँसम्म जरिवाना वा दुवै सजाय हुन सक्छ।

unit_title: Unit 6: Cybersecurity, Threats, NRB Cyber Guidelines & ETA 2063
question_nepali: विद्युतीय कारोबार ऐन, २०६३ अनुसार डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर जारी गर्ने प्रमाणिकरण निकायहरूको नियमन गर्न कुन अधिकारीको व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
question_english: Which statutory regulatory official is designated under the Electronic Transactions Act 2063 to license and supervise Certifying Authorities (CAs) issuing digital signatures in Nepal?
explanation:
The Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA), under the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, licenses, regulates, and monitors Digital Signature Certifying Authorities in Nepal.

unit_title: Unit 1: Financial Institutions in Nepal (Role, Contribution & Status)
question_nepali: बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्था सम्बन्धी ऐन (BAFIA) २०७३ अनुसार वाणिज्य बैंकहरू कुन वर्गमा पर्दछन्?
question_english: According to the Bank and Financial Institutions Act (BAFIA) 2073, which category represents commercial banks in Nepal?
explanation:
Under BAFIA 2073, licensed institutions are classified as Class A (Commercial Banks), Class B (Development Banks), Class C (Finance Companies), and Class D (Microfinance Institutions).

unit_title: Unit 1: Financial Institutions in Nepal (Role, Contribution & Status)
question_nepali: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको निर्देशन अनुसार राष्ट्रिय स्तरको 'क' वर्गको वाणिज्य बैंक खोल्न न्यूनतम चुक्ता पुँजी कति हुनुपर्छ?
question_english: What is the minimum paid-up capital requirement mandated by Nepal Rastra Bank for a national-level Class 'A' commercial bank?
explanation:
NRB Monetary Policy mandated that Class A commercial banks maintain a minimum paid-up capital of Rs. 8 Billion.

नेपाली व्याख्या: वाणिज्य बैंकहरूको न्यूनतम चुक्ता पुँजी रू ८ अर्ब तोकिएको छ।

unit_title: Unit 1: Financial Institutions in Nepal (Role, Contribution & Status)
question_nepali: नेपाल पूर्वाधार विकास बैंक (NIFRA) मुख्यतया कुन क्षेत्रमा कर्जा प्रवाह गर्न स्थापना गरिएको हो?
question_english: Nepal Infrastructure Development Bank (NIFRA) is licensed under BAFIA 2073 specifically to finance:
explanation:
NIFRA was established with a minimum capital of Rs. 20 Billion to mobilize long-term capital for national infrastructure projects.

नेपाली व्याख्या: NIFRA मुख्यतया जलविद्युत्, सडक र विमानस्थल जस्ता ठूला पूर्वाधारमा दीर्घकालीन लगानी गर्न स्थापना भएको हो।

unit_title: Unit 1: Financial Institutions in Nepal (Role, Contribution & Status)
question_nepali: नेपालमा जीवन तथा निर्जीवन बीमा कम्पनीहरूको नियमन र सुपरिवेक्षण कुन निकायले गर्दछ?
question_english: Which regulatory body governs and supervises life and non-life insurance companies in Nepal?
explanation:
The Nepal Insurance Authority (formerly Beema Samiti), established under Insurance Act 2079, regulates all insurance operations in Nepal.

नेपाली व्याख्या: नेपाल बीमा प्राधिकरण (बीमा ऐन २०७९) ले नेपालका सम्पूर्ण बीमा कम्पनीहरूको नियमन गर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 1: Financial Institutions in Nepal (Role, Contribution & Status)
question_nepali: कर्मचारी सञ्चय कोष (EPF) कुन ऐन अन्तर्गत स्थापना भएको हो?
question_english: The Employees Provident Fund (कर्मचारी सञ्चय कोष - EPF) was established under which Act?
explanation:
EPF was established under the Karmachari Sanchaya Kosh Act 2019 BS to manage retirement provident funds for government and corporate employees.

question_english: In the Nepalese financial sector, what is a primary contribution of contractual saving institutions (CIT, EPF, SSF) to economic development (Concept #20)?
options: Mobilizing long-term domestic savings into national capital formation and productive infrastructure
explanation:
Contractual saving institutions channel long-term public savings into government bonds, hydropower, and large-scale capital investments.

question_nepali: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको एकीकृत निर्देशिका अनुसार वाणिज्य बैंकहरूले कायम गर्नुपर्ने अधिकतम कर्जा-निक्षेप (CD) अनुपात कति हो?
question_english: According to NRB Unified Directives, what is the maximum permitted Credit-to-Deposit (CD) ratio for commercial banks in Nepal?

NRB mandates that commercial banks must maintain their Credit-to-Deposit (CD) ratio within a ceiling of 90%.

नेपाली व्याख्या: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको नियम अनुसार बैंकहरूको CD Ratio अधिकतम ९०% भित्र रहनुपर्दछ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Key Basic Banking Terminology & Regulatory Standards
question_nepali: वाणिज्य बैंकहरूले नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकमा अनिवार्य रूपमा राख्नुपर्ने नगद मौज्दात अनुपात (CRR) कति प्रतिशत हो?
question_english: What is the mandatory Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) that commercial banks must deposit with Nepal Rastra Bank?
explanation:
Commercial banks must maintain a Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) of 4.0% of their total domestic deposit liabilities with the central bank.

unit_title: Unit 2: Key Basic Banking Terminology & Regulatory Standards
question_nepali: कर्जा वर्गीकरण सम्बन्धी निर्देशिका अनुसार ९० दिनदेखि १८० दिनसम्म भाखा नाघेको कर्जालाई कुन वर्गमा राखिन्छ?
question_english: Under NRB Unified Directives on loan classification, loans overdue by more than 90 days up to 180 days are categorized as:
explanation:
Substandard loans are overdue by >90 days up to 180 days and require a 25% loan loss provisioning.

नेपाली व्याख्या: ९० दिन देखि १८० दिन सम्म भाखा नाघेको कर्जालाई कमसल (Substandard) भनिन्छ र यसमा २५% नोक्सानी व्यवस्था गर्नुपर्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Key Basic Banking Terminology & Regulatory Standards
question_nepali: १८० दिनदेखि १ वर्षसम्म भाखा नाघेको 'शंकास्पद' (Doubtful) कर्जामा कति प्रतिशत नोक्सानी व्यवस्था (Provision) गर्नुपर्दछ?
question_english: What is the required loan loss provisioning rate for 'Doubtful' loans overdue between 180 days and 365 days?
explanation:
Doubtful loans (>180 days up to 365 days overdue) require a 50% provision against the outstanding loan principal.

नेपाली व्याख्या: शंकास्पद कर्जामा ५०% नोक्सानी व्यवस्था छुट्याउनु पर्ने कानुनी प्रावधान छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Key Basic Banking Terminology & Regulatory Standards
question_nepali: १ वर्ष भन्दा बढी भाखा नाघेको वा कालोसूचीमा परेको 'खराब' (Loss) कर्जामा कति प्रतिशत प्रोभिजनिङ गर्नुपर्दछ?
question_english: What is the loan loss provisioning rate required for 'Loss' loans (overdue by more than 1 year or blacklisted borrowers)?
explanation:
Loss loans (>1 year overdue, blacklisted, or absconding borrower) require a 100% full provisioning.

नेपाली व्याख्या: खराब कर्जामा १००% नोक्सानी व्यवस्था गर्नु अनिवार्य हुन्छ।

unit_title: Unit 2: Key Basic Banking Terminology & Regulatory Standards
question_nepali: बासेल ३ ढाँचा अन्तर्गत प्राथमिक पुँजी (Tier 1 Core Capital) मा कुन-कुन तत्वहरू समावेश हुन्छन् (प्रश्न #1)?
question_english: In commercial banking, what constitutes Tier 1 (Core Capital) under the Basel III capital adequacy framework (Concept #1)?
options: Subordinated term debt and general loan provisions
Paid-up equity share capital, statutory general reserve, retained earnings, and share premium
explanation:
Tier 1 Core Capital consists of permanent paid-up equity capital, statutory general reserves, capital redemption reserves, and retained earnings.

नेपाली व्याख्या: प्राथमिक पुँजीमा चुक्ता पुँजी, साधारण जगेडा कोष, सेयर प्रिमियम र नाफा-नोक्सान हिसाब पर्दछन्।

unit_title: Unit 3: Banking Related Laws (NRB Act, BAFIA, AML/CFT, Banking Offences)
question_nepali: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक ऐन, २०५८ को दफा ४ अनुसार राष्ट्र बैंकको मुख्य उद्देश्य कुन हो?
question_english: According to Section 4 of the Nepal Rastra Bank Act, 2058, which of the following is a primary objective of NRB?
options: To maximize commercial profits from foreign currency trading
To maintain price and balance of payments stability and ensure stability of the banking sector
To provide retail consumer loans directly to the public
explanation:
Section 4 dictates that NRB's primary objective is to maintain price and external balance stability, promote financial stability, and develop a secure payment system.

नेपाली व्याख्या: मूल्य र शोधनान्तर स्थिरता कायम गर्नु तथा वित्तीय क्षेत्रको स्थायित्व सुदृढ बनाउनु राष्ट्र बैंकको मुख्य उद्देश्य हो।

unit_title: Unit 3: Banking Related Laws (NRB Act, BAFIA, AML/CFT, Banking Offences)
question_nepali: बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्था सम्बन्धी ऐन, २०७३ अनुसार बैंकको प्रमुख कार्यकारी अधिकृत (CEO) एक पटकमा बढीमा कति अवधिका लागि नियुक्त हुन सक्दछ?
question_english: Under BAFIA 2073, what is the maximum tenure for which a Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of a bank may be appointed at one time?
explanation:
BAFIA 2073 Section 29 states that a CEO shall be appointed for a tenure not exceeding 4 years and may be reappointed for one more term.

नेपाली व्याख्या: BAFIA अनुसार CEO को पदावधि एक पटकमा बढीमा ४ वर्षको हुन्छ र एक कार्यकाल थप हुन सक्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Banking Related Laws (NRB Act, BAFIA, AML/CFT, Banking Offences)
question_nepali: सम्पत्ति शुद्धीकरण निवारण ऐन, २०६४ अनुसार एकै दिनमा कति रकम भन्दा बढीको कारोबार भएमा FIU मा TTR विवरण पठाउनुपर्छ?
question_english: Under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2064, transactions exceeding what threshold must be reported as Threshold Transactions (TTR/CTR) to the Financial Information Unit (FIU)?
explanation:
Banks must report any cash deposit, withdrawal, or wire transaction of Rs. 1 Million (Rs. 10 Lakhs) or above to the Financial Information Unit (FIU) under TTR regulations.

नेपाली व्याख्या: १० लाख रुपैयाँ वा सोभन्दा बढीको नगद कारोबार भएमा अनिवार्य रूपमा वित्तीय जानकारी इकाई (FIU) मा प्रतिवेदन पठाउनुपर्छ।

unit_title: Unit 3: Banking Related Laws (NRB Act, BAFIA, AML/CFT, Banking Offences)
question_nepali: बैंकिङ कसूर तथा सजाय ऐन, २०६४ अनुसार खातामा पर्याप्त रकम नभएको जानी-जानी चेक काट्नुलाई के मानिन्छ?
question_english: Under Section 3 of the Banking Offences and Punishment Act 2064, what action constitutes the offence of unauthorized cheque issuance (cheque bounce)?
explanation:
Knowingly issuing a cheque without sufficient balance in the account is a criminal banking offence penalized with recovery of the amount, fine, and imprisonment under Section 15.

नेपाली व्याख्या: खातामा रकम नभएको जानी-जानी चेक जारी गर्नु बैंकिङ कसूर मानिन्छ, जसमा बिगो असुल, जरिवाना र कैद सजाय हुन्छ।

question_nepali: विनिमय अधिकारपत्र ऐन, २०३४ अनुसार क्रस चेक (Crossed Cheque) र बेयरर चेक बीचको मुख्य भिन्नता के हो (प्रश्न #1)?
question_english: Under the Negotiable Instruments Act 2034, what distinguishes a 'Crossed Cheque' from a 'Bearer Cheque' (Concept #1)?
options: Crossed cheques can be encashed directly over the counter in cash
Crossed cheques can only be credited to a bank account, providing an audit trail and theft protection
explanation:
Crossed cheques (two parallel transverse lines) prevent direct cash payout at the teller counter and must pass through account collection.

question_nepali: मास्लोको आवश्यकताको शृङ्खला (Hierarchy of Needs) अनुसार मानव उत्प्रेरणाको सबैभन्दा उच्च तह कुन हो?
question_english: According to Abraham Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs, which level of needs represents the highest summit of human motivation?

question_nepali: हर्जवर्गको दुई-तत्व सिद्धान्त अनुसार तलका मध्ये कुन उत्प्रेरक तत्व (Motivator) हो?
question_english: In Herzberg's Dual-Factor Motivation-Hygiene theory, which of the following is classified as a 'Motivator' rather than a 'Hygiene factor'?
explanation:
Hygiene factors (salary, supervision) prevent dissatisfaction, but true motivation stems from motivators like achievement, responsibility, and recognition.

question_english: What are the sequential stages of group development outlined in Bruce Tuckman's famous model?
